description: Aditya Taparia is a computer science PhD student at Arizona State University (LENS Lab), advised by Ransalu Senanayake. He works on the conceptual foundations of neural networks: concept-based explainability, uncertainty in large language models, failure diagnosis of vision-language models, and robust sensor fusion.
